criteria.name: Interest in HackPSU
criteria.description: PLACEHOLDER: How clearly the applicant explains why they want to attend.

levels.description: PLACEHOLDER: No reason given, or the reason is unrelated to the event.
PLACEHOLDER: A general reason for attending, with little that is specific to the applicant.
PLACEHOLDER: A specific, personal reason for attending that connects to what the event offers.

criteria.name: Project idea
criteria.description: PLACEHOLDER: How well the applicant describes something they might build or explore.

levels.description: PLACEHOLDER: No project idea or area of interest.
PLACEHOLDER: A broad idea or area of interest without much detail.
PLACEHOLDER: A concrete idea with a clear problem or goal, at any level of technical complexity.

criteria.name: Learning goals
criteria.description: PLACEHOLDER: How clearly the applicant describes what they hope to learn or gain.

levels.description: PLACEHOLDER: General goals such as 'learn new things' or 'meet people'.
PLACEHOLDER: Specific skills, tools, or experiences the applicant wants to gain.
